papers.paperTitleMr: सहाय्यक संचालक, नगर रचना, नगर रचना व मूल्यनिर्धारण विभाग, वर्ग-अ (राजपत्रित) नगर विकास विभाग

topics: Scientific Knowledge: Nature of Science, Pre-suppositions of Science, Scientific method.
Modernisation and Science: What is Modernisation (Definition of Modernisation), Type and Nature of Modernisation, Modernisation and Indian Society (Problems and remedies)
Scientific and Technological Developments (The World over, particularly in India)
Effects of Technological Developments on Urban and Rural Life

Various Indian Problems And Their Scientific Solutions: For Example - Energy problem, Foodgrains problem, Population problem, Environment Problem, Educational problem, Housing problem, Transport problem, Communication problem, Public Health problem etc.
Theories governing the Urban Land use Planning, Site Planning, Neighbourhood Planning, Hierarchy of Central Places, zoning, Development Control regulations.
Transportation studies, Origin & Destination, Traffic volume survey, modal split.
Study of Urbanization Trends at National and State level.
Necessary steps for starting and ending the process of Regional Planning
Relation with the state plan and surroundings
Metropolitan Area Plans as per 74th Constitutional Amendment
Legal and administrative processes to initiate preparation of Development Plans
Planning alternatives goals and objectives & Public Participation
Major plans and reports needed for Development Plans
Contents of D.P. (Section 22) – including reservation of sites and Development Control regulations
Modifications (Section 37) purchase notice (Section 49), Notice under Section 127 and appeal (Section 47)
Terms and concepts – Arbitrator, Tribunal of Appeal, Original Plot, Final Plot, Incremental Contribution
Rational behind charging of incremental contribution
Development charge and concept behind it
Factors to be considered while granting development permission.
Provisions for Action against unauthorised Development
Supply of landed property and factors affecting it
Demand for landed property and factors affecting it
The Direct comparison or Comparative method
The Contractors method and its weaknesses
The Residual method (When to be used, Latent value, Cost of Development)

Income Capitalization method (Investment, Year’s Purchase – Single Interest Y.P. and Double Interest Y.P., Estimation of Gross income, outgoings and Net income, Rates of Interest for years purchase, Advantages and Disadvantages of Investment in landed property, Yield and its relationship with price, Factors governing investment)
Valuation of leasehold properties- Apportionment of interest of lessor and lessee
Need of compulsory acquisition - Eminent Domain
Procedure of Land Acquisition under L.A. Act 1894
Factors to be taken into account while estimating the compensation
Factors which are not to be taken into account while estimating the compensation
Various other Acts in Maharashtra for acquisition and method of estimating compensation under those Acts
